title: Red Sea International unit expands SNB facilities to $115mln
summary: The facilities will be used to issue advance payment bonds, performance bonds and LCs
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
The facilities will be used to issue advance payment bonds, performance bonds and LCs

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Subsidiary of Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea International, a Tadawul-listed construction and contracting company, has increased its financing facilities agreement with Saudi National Bank (SNB) to SAR 430.8 million ($115 million) from SAR 200 million ($53.4 million) previously.
